title: A handoff has a release time
hook: The reviewer cannot start with a draft that has not finished.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a dependent task can start only when its input is finished, so the second task starts when the first one ends

misconception: The next person can start as soon as the first person starts.
objective: Schedule a dependent task after its input is ready.
